urdu transliteration:
Ay Shiayun Imshab, Shaame Gharibaan Ast
Jisme Hussain Ooryaan, Oon Dar Bayaabaan Ast
english translation text:
O SHIAS, TONIGHT IS SHAM-E-GHARIBAN
THE BLESSED BODY OF HUSSAIN LIES BARE THERE IN THE WILDERNESS

urdu transliteration: Ay Shiayun Imshab, Shaame Gharibaan Ast

Dar Karbala Imshab, Zaari-O-Afghaan Ast
Jisme Ali Akbar, Oon Dar Bayaabaan Ast
english translation text:
IN KARBALA TONIGHT, THERE IS WEEPING AND LAMENTATION
THE BLESSED BODY OF ALI AKBAR LIES THERE IN THE WILDERNESS

urdu transliteration: Ay Shiayun Imshab, Shaame Gharibaan Ast

Ba Haalate Mahzoon, Choon Na Sha Har Dar Khoon
Bar Deedane Oonha, Har Chashme Giryaan Ast
english translation text:
IN A STATE OF SORROW, AS EACH ONE LIES IN BLOOD
AT THE SIGHT OF THEM, EVERY EYE IS WEEPING

urdu transliteration: Ay Shiayun Imshab, Shaame Gharibaan Ast

Choon Zaynabe Mahzoon, Baa Deedan-E-Giryaan
Guft Ay Biraadar Jaan, Maa Beekas Aur Yaareem
english translation text:
WHEN GRIEF-STRICKEN ZAINAB SAW THIS WITH WEEPING EYES
SHE SAID: O DEAR BROTHER, WE ARE HELPLESS AND WITHOUT SUPPORT

urdu transliteration: Ay Shiayun Imshab, Shaame Gharibaan Ast

Khatme Rasool Aayad, Ba Jumlaae Hamraahan
Az Qatle Farzandash, Girya-O-Naalaan Ast
english translation text:
THE SEAL OF THE PROPHETS ARRIVES, WITH ALL THOSE WITH HIM
OVER THE MARTYRDOM OF HIS BELOVED CHILD, HE WEEPS AND LAMENTS

urdu transliteration: Ay Shiayun Imshab, Shaame Gharibaan Ast

Zaaki Dar Een Majlis, Siddiqe Qubra Hast
Az Daaghe Farzandash, Ba Qalbe Soozaan Ast
english translation text:
ZAAKI, IN THIS MAJLIS, SIDDIQAH-E-KUBRA IS PRESENT
FROM THE WOUND OF HER SON, HER HEART IS BURNING
